name: mamachoice
description: Israeli Hebrew buying guides for baby products: find a guide, its products in ILS and FAQ, or search live.

interface.longDescription:
MamaChoice (אמא בוחרת) answers Israeli parents' baby-product questions from its Hebrew buying guides: equipment checklists for a newborn, diaper bags, sippy cups and feeding, sleep, strollers and carriers, toys by age, home safety, travel with a baby, birth gifts, and the VAT and customs rules for ordering from abroad.

What it does: three read-only tools. search_guides finds the guides that match a topic, in Hebrew or English. get_guide returns one guide in full: its products with prices in shekels and a link to the AliExpress listing with delivery to Israel, plus its frequently asked questions and answers. search_baby_products runs a live search of baby and parenting products with delivery to Israel and prices in shekels.

Who it is for: parents and parents-to-be in Israel, and anyone shopping for a baby in Israel.

Limitations: the guides are written in Hebrew; prices are as of each guide's update date and are set by AliExpress sellers, so they can change. It does not place orders, track parcels or give medical advice. Purchases are completed on AliExpress.

Disclosure: product links are AliExpress affiliate links - MamaChoice may earn a commission at no extra cost to the buyer. Products are chosen by order count, rating and buyer reviews, not by payment. No account or personal data is needed. Privacy: the search text a tool receives is processed by MamaChoice's search engine and may be sent to an AI language-model provider (to understand the request) and to the AliExpress Affiliate API (to fetch products); product searches are kept anonymously in a rolling log for at most 12 months. Full details: https://mamachoice.co.il/privacy
defaultPrompt: Which diaper bag should I buy? I live in Israel
מה צריך לקנות לתינוק שנולד? תן לי רשימה

positive.description: Hebrew product question that a guide covers
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_guides with the Hebrew topic, then get_guide on the diaper-bag guide; lists bags with prices in ILS and links.

positive.description: English question about a baby product, for Israel
positive.prompt: What sippy cup is good for a 6 month old? I'm in Israel
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the sippy-cups guide and shows its cups with ILS prices and the guide's answer on spout vs straw vs 360 cups.

positive.prompt: Gift ideas: toys for a 1 year old, delivery to Israel
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the toys-for-a-1-year-old guide (and related age guides) with links and example products.

positive.prompt: האם משלמים מכס על הזמנה של מוצרי תינוק מעלי אקספרס?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the AliExpress guide and answers from its FAQ on VAT and customs, pointing to the Israel Tax Authority calculator.

positive.prompt: Find me a baby bath thermometer with delivery to Israel
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_baby_products; shows bath thermometers with ILS prices, ratings, orders and links.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Tel Aviv tomorrow?
My baby has a fever of 39, what medicine should I give?

negative.description: Request to place an order (the app cannot buy)
negative.prompt: Buy the first diaper bag for me and pay with my card
